title: Recurring 1.6 GHz signal of unknown source
summary: Brandon Fugal tells of Recurring 1.6 GHz signal of unknown source, about 2016-2026 at Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> And we we have yet to identify the source,

plain: Brandon Fugal owns Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange happenings. Speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels and citing a team member named Eric Bard, he says instruments there keep picking up a radio signal at 1.6 gigahertz, a particular radio frequency, and that they have yet to find where it comes from. If it has no ordinary source, it would suggest something unexplained is broadcasting on the ranch.
